literal: Generosity, compassion, an upright sceptre, and protecting subjects—he who possesses these four is a light to kings.
translation: He who possesses these four qualities—generosity, compassion, a just rule, and care for his subjects—is a shining light among rulers.
modern: கொடைத்தன்மை, கருணை, நேர்மையான ஆட்சி, குடிமக்களைக் காத்தல் ஆகிய நான்கையும் உடையவன் அரசர்களுக்குள் ஒளி போன்றவன் ஆவான்.
explanation: This couplet outlines the four essential pillars of ideal governance. 'கொடை' represents the ruler's generosity, while 'அளி' denotes grace and compassion toward all living beings. 'செங்கோல்' (literally 'upright sceptre') signifies unbiased, righteous justice, and 'குடியோம்பல்' refers to the active protection and nurturing of the citizens. A ruler who embodies all four of these virtues stands out as a guiding light ('ஒளி') and an exemplar among other kings.
